findings.claim: 公司稱美國出口管制預計使 FY2026 營收減少約 6 億美元（Q4 減 1.1 億）；另有報導引述 7.1 億美元口徑
findings.source: Reuters 經 Yahoo Finance：Applied Materials sees weaker China spending in 2026 on tighter US curbs
findings.excerpt: The new rules are expected to reduce Applied Materials' fourth-quarter revenue by $110 million and 2026 revenue by $600 million

findings.claim: 中國營收占比由近 40% 降至 20% 中段；CEO 指非美系設備商不受同等限制，受限客戶可轉向對手（日期為推定，原文發布日未於摘要中確認）
findings.source: Reuters 經 Korea JoongAng Daily：Applied Materials sees weaker China spending in 2026 on tighter US curbs
findings.excerpt: Non-U.S. equipment companies don't have the same restrictions, and so restricted customers can buy from those companies, even if they would rather buy from Applied,

note: 搜尋摘要未取得製造據點（新加坡／馬來西亞等）的一手資料；第二手稱 Q3 FY26 中國占兩大核心部門營收 24%（前季 27%），亞洲占總營收 84%，及 2.53 億美元出口管制和解金，皆來自低可信度聚合站，未列入 findings，需 10-K 查證。
